fusions.name: Burning Wadding
fusions.desc: Fires point-blank, spraying burning wadding in a cone 3 tiles ahead that deals 4 fire damage to everything in it, with a 25% chance to leave each target [Burning] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Smothering Round
fusions.desc: Fires a cloth-wrapped round into the first enemy in its path for 12 damage, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Suppressed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Swab the Barrel
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Quilted Coat
fusions.desc: Conjures a quilted coat: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, and 5% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
